body.statement: In the canonical lvLiNGAM model of Tramontano, Kivva, Salehkaleybar, Kiyavash, and Drton, the observed coordinates are linear mixtures of mutually independent, nondegenerate, non-Gaussian exogenous coordinates.  Their order-\(r\) cumulant parameterization allows an unrestricted diagonal source-cumulant tensor at each retained order.  Their Figure~3 is the single-proxy graph on \(Z,T,Y\) with \(\ell\) latent common causes and the directed edges \(Z\to T\to Y\).  Theorems~3.1 and 3.4--3.5 give, respectively, the bivariate root construction and proxy-effect sufficiency through order \(k(\ell)\), while Theorem~3.6 claims failure of order-three identification when \(\ell=1\).

attestation.note: Checked against the PMLR 267 published PDF, Section 2.2, Figure 3, and the displayed statements of Theorems 3.1 and 3.4--3.6. A stable source handle is supplied because the node paraphrases several separately located statements.
